subtitle.en: An original reflection on learning through observation, useful questions, and evidence gathered by hand.
subtitle.zh: 一篇原创美文：关于用观察、有效问题与亲手收集的证据来学习。

note.en: Public-domain inspiration from the practice of patient field observation; this lesson is wholly original and reproduces no source wording.
note.zh: 灵感来自公开领域作品中耐心田野观察的实践；本课为全新原创，不复述原文。

warmup.en: Read with alert curiosity. Make the concrete details crisp and the questions spacious.
warmup.zh: 带着敏锐的好奇心朗读。具体细节要清晰，问题要留出空间。

title.en: Knowledge with Mud on Its Shoes

intro.en: This original passage invites learners to move beyond collecting answers and begin collecting evidence.
intro.zh: 这篇原创文章邀请学习者越过收集答案的阶段，开始收集证据。

sections.text: A field notebook is not only for scientists crossing distant islands. It belongs wherever reality can interrupt a theory: beside a classroom window, inside a workshop, during a customer call, at the edge of a garden. Its pages say, before any discovery is made, I expect the world to exceed my first explanation. That expectation changes attention. Instead of recording only what confirms the plan, you begin to notice the late delivery, the bird that returns at a different hour, the question students ask after the official lesson has ended.

coaching.en: Read the list of settings with widening curiosity. Let I expect the world sound like a personal promise.
coaching.zh: 把不同场景的列举读出逐渐扩大的好奇。让 I expect the world 像一句个人承诺。

sections.text: Observation becomes unreliable when judgment arrives too early. Write the visible action before the flattering or fearful story. Not careless employee, but three labels were attached to the wrong boxes between two and three o’clock. Not difficult child, but she covered her ears when the chairs scraped the floor. Description creates room for causes we have not considered. It also makes conversation kinder. Specific facts can be examined together; labels merely recruit people to defend or accuse. Precision is not coldness. Often it is the first practical form of compassion.

coaching.en: Separate each label from its observed detail. Land gently but clearly on compassion.
coaching.zh: 把每个标签与观察到的事实区分开。结尾的 compassion 要温和而清楚。

sections.text: A good note does more than preserve a moment. It produces the next question. Why did the error cluster in one hour? What changed in the sound of the room? Which plants recovered after shade arrived? These questions are smaller than grand theories, but they have handles. You can return tomorrow, compare, count, ask another person, or alter one condition. Learning accelerates when curiosity becomes testable. The notebook turns wonder into a sequence: notice, describe, question, try, revise. Each verb is modest. Together they can remake a practice.

coaching.en: Give the three questions distinct shapes. Read the five verbs as a memorable working sequence.
coaching.zh: 让三个问题各有清晰形态。把五个动词读成容易记住的工作流程。

title.en: 4. Review for the Detail That Changed You
title.zh: 4. 回看那个改变你的细节

sections.text: At the end of a week, do not ask only what you achieved. Ask what corrected you. Perhaps a repeated complaint exposed a design flaw. Perhaps a seedling survived where your handbook predicted failure. Perhaps the quietest person in the group named the pattern everyone else had missed. Such moments protect us from becoming experts in our own expectations. Keep them close. Knowledge gathered in the field carries weather, friction, timing, and other lives. It has mud on its shoes, and for that reason it knows the way home.

coaching.en: Make each correction feel welcome, not embarrassing. Slow down for the final image and finish warmly.
coaching.zh: 把每次纠正读成值得欢迎的事，而不是尴尬。结尾意象要放慢，并温暖收束。

meaning.en: To stop the usual flow of something for a time.
meaning.zh: 打断；暂时中止某事的正常进程。

use.en: A surprising result interrupted our neat theory.
use.zh: 一个意外结果打断了我们整齐的理论。

meaning.en: To provide evidence that something is true.
meaning.zh: 证实；提供证据表明某事为真。

use.en: The second test confirmed the pattern.
use.zh: 第二次测试证实了这个规律。

meaning.en: To gather or occur closely together.

use.en: Most errors clustered near the end of the shift.
use.zh: 大多数错误集中发生在轮班结束前。

meaning.en: Able to be checked through observation or experiment.
meaning.zh: 可检验的；能够通过观察或实验核查的。

use.en: Turn the broad idea into a testable question.
use.zh: 把宽泛的想法变成一个可检验的问题。

meaning.en: To change an idea or piece of work after reconsidering it.
meaning.zh: 修订；重新思考后改变想法或作品。

use.en: We revised the process after watching it closely.
use.zh: 仔细观察后，我们修订了流程。

meaning.en: A weakness or problem built into the way something was designed.
meaning.zh: 设计缺陷；事物设计方式中固有的弱点或问题。

use.en: User notes revealed a design flaw in the form.
use.zh: 用户记录揭示了表单中的设计缺陷。

pronunciationFocus.en: Keep the repeated consonants clear in reality can interrupt a theory.
pronunciationFocus.zh: 在 reality can interrupt a theory 中把重复辅音读清楚。

pronunciationFocus.en: Use clean contrast in not careless employee, but three labels.
pronunciationFocus.zh: 在 not careless employee, but three labels 中读出清晰对比。

pronunciationFocus.en: Give equal beats to notice, describe, question, try, revise.
pronunciationFocus.zh: 为 notice、describe、question、try、revise 分配均匀节拍。

prompt.en: Shadow as if you are sharing discoveries with a thoughtful colleague in the field.
prompt.zh: 跟读时，想象你正与一位细心的田野同事分享发现。

steps.en: Pass one: make every observed detail concrete.
steps.zh: 第一遍：把每个观察细节读得具体。

steps.en: Pass two: lift your tone slightly when a new question appears.
steps.zh: 第二遍：出现新问题时语调微微上扬。

steps.en: Pass three: give the final metaphor patience and warmth.
steps.zh: 第三遍：耐心而温暖地读出结尾隐喻。

reflection.en: What did you observe this week that challenged your first explanation?
reflection.zh: 本周你观察到什么，挑战了最初的解释？

reflection.en: Which label could you replace with a more precise description?
reflection.zh: 你可以把哪个标签换成更精确的描述？
